#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

ll modpow(ll b, ll e) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = (r * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n;
    ll k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<ll> fact(n+1), inv(n+1);
    fact[0] = inv[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % MOD;
    inv[n] = modpow(fact[n], MOD-2);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 1; i--) inv[i] = ((i+1) * inv[i+1]) % MOD;
    
    auto nCr = [&](int n, int r) -> ll {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * inv[n-r] % MOD * inv[r] % MOD;
    };
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    int r = n - (int)k;
    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
        ll term = (ll)sign * nCr(r, i) % MOD * modpow(r - i, n) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        sign = -sign;
    }
    ll result = (2 * nCr(n, r) % MOD * ans) % MOD;
    if (result < 0) result += MOD;
    cout << result << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
